abstract: arXiv:2605.02989v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This manuscript contains preprint of a chapter in the forthcoming third edition of Cover and Thomas's Elements of Information Theory, posted with permission from Wiley. For feedback, please contact abbas@ee.stanford.edu.   Learning and information theory intersect in both model training and the characterization of fundamental performance limits. This manuscript provides a concise and accessible treatment of the first intersection, requiring only basic background in information theory and statistics at the senior undergraduate / first-year graduate level. End-of-chapter exercises make the material well suited for classroom use as well as self-study. translated_abstract: 本手稿是即将出版的Cover和Thomas所著《信息论基础》第三版中一章的预印本，经Wiley出版社许可发布。如需反馈，请联系abbas@ee.stanford.edu。学习与信息论在模型训练和基本性能极限的刻画这两个方面均存在交集。本手稿对第一个交集进行了简明且易于理解的阐述，仅要求读者具备高年级本科生/一年级研究生水平的信息论和统计学基础。章末习题使得这些内容非常适合课堂教学和自学使用。本章重点讨论了散度度量在模型训练中的作用，示例涵盖从线性和逻辑回归到自回归模型、变分自编码器、扩散模型以及基于分数的模型。特别是，对生成扩散（模型的处理……）
tldr: 该论文章节简明阐述了散度度量在统计学习模型训练中的核心作用，示例涵盖从线性回归、变分自编码器到扩散模型等多种模型。
en_tdlr: This book chapter provides a concise treatment of the central role of divergence measures in statistical model training, with examples ranging from linear regression and variational autoencoders to diffusion and score-based models.
